demonstrations.review_reason: Three complete alternating transfers independently verified in video contact sheet and denser placement review; final release is visible before clip ends. Pickup is approximate measured lift onset; release is approximate video annotation. Stationary detector merges transfers because resting position jitter exceeds its threshold. Endpoints use measured resting medians. Inner transport phases remain automatic and need semantic review.
